parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel, forming the main upper structure that applies pressure to drive staples through paper.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal spring and staple pusher mechanism, and transfers the pressing force to the staple head.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear, moving downward to press staples and upward to reload.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is a plastic cover that encloses the top portion of the body, providing a comfortable surface for pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective and ergonomic cover, allowing users to press down easily without direct contact with metal parts.
parts.Movement_description: It moves together with the body during stapling, pivoting around the hinge.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel and forms the bottom support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for the stapler, holds the anvil plate that bends the staple legs, and ensures alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the foundation for the stapler’s moving parts.
